title: Reinstatement Courtesy for Comfort Club Members with a Harbison Installation
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements members who have had a Harbison replacement installation receive a courtesy against the reinstatement fee. The rule reads the member installation credits posted on the member's installation contracts under Replacement System Installations.

## Installation courtesy rule
| Most recent member installation credit on a Harbison installation contract | Courtesy taken off the fee |
|---|---|
| Posted fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the date of handling | 10.00 USD (the recent-installation courtesy) |
| Posted 12 or more but fewer than 36 whole calendar months before | 5.00 USD (the older-installation courtesy) |
| None posted, or posted 36 or more whole calendar months before | none |

Only the most recent member installation credit decides the band.

## Examples (hypothetical members)
- Member installation credit posted 5 months ago: 10.00.
- Most recent credit posted 20 months ago: 5.00.
- Exactly 12 whole months ago: 5.00. Exactly 36 whole months ago: none.
- An installation with no member installation credit posted: none.
